maria-ml: Quick note — ran speculative decoding + 4-bit q4_0 quant on titan-rt for the draft-model bringup. Observed ~6–8% token throughput speedup but an unexpected entropy bump on longprompt tests. Anyone seen this before?

aj: Which eval set are you using? longprompt = story-coherence or the 2k-token summarization set? Can you paste the run id/logs?

maria-ml: Eval set = long-seq-story (2k tails). Run id run_2026_03_specX (uploaded). Quick log snippet: ```entropy.tail_mean: fp16=6.21 -> q4_spec=6.81; ppl: 12.3 -> 12.5; kl_ref: 0.08 -> 0.21```

eval-bot: eval-bot: new eval uploaded: https://internal.redwood/runs/run_2026_03_specX metrics summary attached (ppl:12.3->12.5, kl_ref:0.08->0.21, ent_tail:+0.6)

kevin-t: We've hit similar-looking noise when KV-cache warmup timing differs between speculative and non-spec paths. Are you doing any explicit cache warming or different scheduling in the spec path?

maria-ml: No explicit warm steps — using runtime default aggressive_prefetch: true (speculative path uses early-return for partial logits). Hypothesis: speculative prefetch returns early logits computed with quantized kernels that have slightly different scaling, so tail entropy drifts.

olga: Sounds plausible. Two quick checks: (1) rerun with deterministic softmax temp=1.0 and (2) compute per-token logits L2 diff between fp16 baseline and q4 outputs (before softmax). If diffs concentrate on tail tokens that'd indicate quant/noise.

derek: Also double-check the post-softmax renorm/clamp we added in the A100 kernel to prevent overflow — that clamp can shift low-prob mass. Might interact with q4 rounding in weird ways.

aj: Ops plan: run a 4-way ablation: (A) fp16 + no-spec, (B) fp16 + spec, (C) q4 + no-spec, (D) q4 + spec. 100 samples each from long-seq-story. Measure ppl/kl/coherence and save raw logits. If the KL reg is only in (D) it's interaction effect.

maria-ml: On it. Ablation script and harness: https://git.internal/mltools/ablation/spec_ablate.py. Spinning job now.

eval-bot: eval-bot: queued ablation job job_9832 (100 samples x 4 configs). Will post per-config artifacts when done.

olga: :thumbsup: If we confirm kernel clamp + q4 interaction, a short-term patch is to disable clamp for speculative-prefetch paths, or re-run softmax with a small rescale factor. Add the rescale flag to the ablation to test.

kevin-t: If it's a kernel-level issue, long-term we should ensure deterministic post-quant scaling so speculative returns are bit-compatible with fp16 within epsilon. For rollout decisions, set an automated gate: if kl_ref increases >0.05 on long-seq, block canary.

aj: Agreed. We'll reconvene after job_9832 finishes. If we see regression, collect 10 failing samples and open a regressions ticket with diffs + waveforms.

maria-ml: Thanks all — will post results and raw artifacts here when eval-bot finishes.
